steps.title: Define NoteWise Specifications
steps.description: Establish NoteWise feature requirements: sqlite-powered storage, categorized note classification, instant queries, custom pastel backgrounds, and clean dialog screens.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Apply AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 compatibility variables matching Temurin JDK 17 standard requirements.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest Rules
steps.description: Set NoteWise package name space, map icon dependencies, and define theme values.

steps.title: Configure Colors and Layout Values
steps.description: Establish resources/color palettes for note cards including pastel pink, peach, yellow, green, and blue.

steps.title: Design Activity Layout
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml layout including action buttons, horizontal filtering tray, and empty status viewports.

steps.title: Design Note Cards and Lists
steps.description: Create custom XML card layouts to display notes with dynamic highlights, categories, snippets, and action buttons.

steps.title: Design Editor and Category Dialogs
steps.description: Build responsive overlay dialog templates for note creation, modification, color choices, and managing custom category filters.

steps.title: Develop Category and Note Data Models
steps.description: Implement clean Category.java and Note.java domain objects representing structured note data.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Engine
steps.description: Design DatabaseHelper.java to manage database operations, query filtering, and automatic default seeding.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Incorporate NoteWise main execution routines, search field watchers, dynamic category chip renderers, and SQLite queries.

steps.title: Incorporate Custom Adapter Adapters
steps.description: Wire lists inside MainActivity to customize background color cards dynamically.

steps.title: Building NoteWise
steps.description: Execute native assembly build step creating debug APK package output files.
